summary: Geopolitical alerts that can move oil. Scans every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

netRead.bottom: The Kirishi refinery fire, Hormuz missile fire, the Khor Mor strike and a Houthi Abqaiq claim keep risk skewed up despite Trump's dovish talk.

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (claim issued ~9:40 pm SGT, 8 Nov)
alerts.headline: Houthis claim they struck Aramco's Abqaiq oil processing site, plus Riyadh's airport, Aramco oil tanks and the financial centre; neither Riyadh nor Aramco confirms any Abqaiq hit
alerts.source: AMK Mapping, citing Houthi statement; also CGTN Europe, MTV Lebanon

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Kirishi (KINEF) oil refinery, one of its largest; large fire burning, and Leningrad governor Drozdenko reports a successful attack on the refinery
alerts.source: Woofers; Leningrad governor via First Squawk; also OSINTtechnical, AMK Mapping

alerts.headline: Ukrainian mass drone raid (hundreds of drones reported) hits sites near St. Petersburg; drones spotted near Kirishi refinery, a Baltic export-linked plant (unconfirmed)
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical; Woofers; Open Source Intelligence

alerts.headline: Drone attack hits Iraq's Khor Mor gas field in Kurdistan; production halted and power cuts reported in Erbil and Duhok (Reuters, security sources)
alerts.source: Giovanni Staunovo, citing Reuters; also Open Source Intel; Post Open Source

alerts.headline: Iranian state TV says three missiles were launched from Sirik toward 'non-compliant' vessels in the Strait of Hormuz; no hits or ship names reported
alerts.source: Basha Report, citing Iranian state TV; also Open Source Intel; Post Open Source

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Explosions reported tonight on Iran's Qeshm Island and near Bandar Abbas; IRNA says sites appear struck, and OSINT attributes a third night of US air-defense strikes near the Strait of Hormuz
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical; also First Squawk, citing IRNA; OSINTdefender; Open Source Intel

alerts.eventTime: Sun 8 Nov 2026 (est., CNN interview; clock time not specified)
alerts.headline: Trump tells CNN it is 'highly unlikely' the US will return to war with Iran if negotiations on a nuclear deal and reopening the Strait of Hormuz progress
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing CNN

alerts.headline: Israeli Defense Minister Katz says Israel's mission against Iran is not complete, that Iran is trying to renew its nuclear program, and that Israel will take preemptive action
alerts.source: The Hormuz Letter; also Mario Nawfal

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: ADNOC-linked products tanker Navig8 Messi identified as the vessel hit by Iran's IRGC northwest of Khasab, Oman; the ship is on fire
alerts.source: Open Source Intel; also MenchOsint

alerts.eventTime: Sun 8 Nov, ~12:00 pm SGT (est., Riyadh morning rush hour)
alerts.headline: Houthi missiles targeted Riyadh on Sunday, including the King Abdullah Financial District; AFP witnesses and Bloomberg report damage to an Aramco building, while the Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted the missiles
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, citing Bloomberg; also AFP

alerts.eventTime: Sat 7 Nov ~1:30 pm SGT (est., 'this morning' Iran time)
alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Iran's Navy says a 'non-compliant' oil tanker hit a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, caught fire and stopped; no ship name, no UKMTO confirmation
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (via Fars/IRNA)

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted a Houthi cruise missile targeting Riyadh
alerts.source: FirstSquawk

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Saratov (Rosneft) oil refinery on the Volga; multiple fires reported, ~140 kbpd capacity; seventh Russian refinery hit in about eight days
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical / OSINTdefender / Kyiv Independent

alerts.headline: Trump and AP confirm US carried out small-scale / targeted strikes on Iranian anti-aircraft on Qeshm Island near Hormuz (upgrade of earlier OSINT reports)
alerts.source: Amena Bakr (AP) / First Squawk / OSINTdefender

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: US forces reportedly conducted two airstrikes on an Iranian surface-to-air missile launcher near Quza/Suza on Qeshm Island after it allegedly fired at a US FA-18 over the Strait of Hormuz; explosions and air-defence activity reported locally.
alerts.source: AMK Mapping

alerts.headline: UKMTO: a tanker outbound through the Strait of Hormuz reported an explosion at the waterline, port side, 16 nm east of Khasab, Oman; crew safe, vessel kept power and continued its voyage. Time-late report, so incident time unknown
alerts.source: UKMTO notice, via Live Squawk; also ILRedAlert

alerts.headline: Satellite imagery reportedly shows an unusual fire at an Aramco gas facility in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province; no cause, site name or official confirmation yet (single OSINT claim)
alerts.source: Post Open Source (CocoPostel), citing AB4_Ali3

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed a drone in Saudi Arabia's Mecca region (home to Jeddah and its oil facilities); it did not name the launcher or target, though Houthi attacks on the kingdom have been repeated
alerts.source: Saudi-led coalition spokesman, via Arab News; also Al Arabiya English, Anadolu

alerts.eventTime: Meetings Wed-Thu (4-5 Nov, US); report ~6:10 pm, 6 Nov (est.)
alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Fox News reports US Central Command is finalizing options for renewed operations against Iran after Trump met his national security team; Trump says a decision on resuming the war will come soon
alerts.source: Open Source Intel on X, citing Fox News; several outlets relay Trump's 'decide soon' remark

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (attack 3 Nov; halt reported 5:17 pm, 6 Nov)
alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Russia's Yanos (Slavneft-YANOS) refinery in Yaroslavl has halted operations after the 3 Nov Ukrainian drone attack, per wire-style headlines; no restart date given
alerts.source: FinSquawk headline (#OOTT); also World in Motion

alerts.headline: Ukraine reportedly confirms its strike on Russia's Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai (about 7 million tonnes a year), upgrading earlier OSINT reports; Russia had cited only a debris fire at an industrial site
alerts.source: FinancialJuice headline (relayed by several wire-style accounts)

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at Najran; debris fell and damage is being assessed (possibly the same attack as the 3:01 pm warning)
alerts.source: Saudi-led coalition via Arab News; First Squawk

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Iran's IRGC Navy says two more tankers struck mines and caught fire while trying to transit the Strait of Hormuz (via IRNA); unclear if this is a new incident or a restatement of earlier ones
alerts.source: First Squawk citing IRGC Navy / IRNA; FinSquawk (Iranian state media claim, no independent confirmation)

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense issues another early-warning alert in Najran province (Yemen border), the second there in about six hours; no impact disclosed yet

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: FT reports negotiators are working toward an agreement to end the Iran war, though Iran's security chief earlier said Hormuz stays shut until seven conditions are met
alerts.source: First Squawk relaying the Financial Times (wire headline; no official confirmation)

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Ukrainian drones reportedly hit the Afipsky oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai (about 7 million tonnes a year); fires and explosions reported in Krasnodar
alerts.source: LetsArmUKR and several OSINT accounts (Ukrainian OSINT; no official confirmation yet)

alerts.headline: Saudi Aramco cuts December Arab Light OSP to Asia to a $7/bbl discount, about $2 lower across Asia grades
alerts.source: LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claims a drone strike on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam disrupted air traffic; no immediate Saudi confirmation
alerts.source: Yah_Saree

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense issues a second early-warning in Sharurah (Najran/Yemen border); danger passed about six minutes later, no impact disclosed

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed a drone over Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province
alerts.source: Al Jazeera Breaking

alerts.headline: Iran Navy says two more oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, after defying warnings; reports put it at five tankers and a tug hit today

alerts.headline: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree denies Medina intercept claim; says operations target only Saudi oil facilities and military bases

alerts.headline: Oman and Iran discuss efforts to resume navigation in the Strait of Hormuz (ONA)
alerts.source: First Squawk citing ONA

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Yanbu (Red Sea oil export and refining hub); no impact disclosed yet
alerts.source: First Squawk citing Saudi Civil Defense; Al Jazeera Breaking / Asharq Al-Awsat

alerts.eventTime: 4 Nov (est., UKMTO report date; clock not stated)

alerts.headline: Saudi Civil Defense sounds early-warning alert in Sharurah (Najran province, Yemen border), then declares danger passed about 9 minutes later; no impact disclosed

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Iran said it fired missiles from Sirik at non-compliant ships in Hormuz, a drone strike halted Iraq's Khor Mor gas field, and the Houthis claimed a strike on Aramco's Abqaiq site.
Blasts hit Qeshm and Bandar Abbas, a Houthi strike damaged an Aramco building in Riyadh, and Ukrainian drones set Russia's Kirishi refinery ablaze, confirmed by the regional governor.
